Definition: from G3793; to mob, i.e. (by implication) to harass:--vex.
BiblicalUsage: Ochleo means to be vexed, or harassed, mobbed by something evil. It occurs once, in Acts 5:16, where people bring the sick and those vexed with unclean spirits to Jerusalem, and they are healed every one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the vexed were healed every one, and no unclean spirit is too strong for the name that healed them.
